name: vscode-esbmc
description: Verify C and C++ programs from VS Code with ESBMC, the Efficient SMT-based Bounded Model Checker

esbmc.frontEnd.includePath.markdownDescription: Sets include path to a given value

esbmc.frontEnd.includeAfter.markdownDescription: Enable or disable system include path to search after system headers, `#esbmc.includePath#` must be set if enabled

markdownEnumDescriptions: Run the full verification pipeline without stopping early
Stop after preprocessing (`--preprocess`)
Disable inlining of function calls (`--no-inlining`)
Perform full inlining of function calls (`--full-inlining`)
Show the loops in the program (`--show-loops`)
Only show the claims generated for the program (`--show-claims`)
Show the verification conditions (`--show-vcc`)
esbmc.frontEnd.programLoopClaimVcs.markdownDescription: Stop the front end after a given stage, or show the program's loops, claims or verification conditions instead of verifying it

esbmc.frontEnd.claimRemoval.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the removal of claims

markdownEnumDescriptions: Treat the machine word as 16 bits wide (`--16`)
Treat the machine word as 32 bits wide (`--32`)
Treat the machine word as 64 bits wide
Set MACOS/I386 architecture (`--i386-macos`)
Set PPC/I386 architecture (`--ppc-macos`)
Set Linux/I386 architecture
Set Windows/I386 architecture (`--i386-win32`)
Take the endianness from the selected architecture
Allow little-endian word-byte conversions (`--little-endian`)
Allow big-endian word-byte conversions (`--big-endian`)
esbmc.frontEnd.endianness.markdownDescription: Sets the endianness for word-byte conversions

markdownEnumDescriptions: Verify the program without dumping any intermediate representation
Only show the symbol table (`--symbol-table-only`)
Show the symbol table and verify (`--symbol-table-too`)
Only show the parse tree (`--parse-tree-only`)
Show the parse tree and verify (`--parse-tree-too`)
Only show the GOTO program (`--goto-functions-only`)
Show the GOTO program and verify (`--goto-functions-too`)
Only show the program expression (`--program-only`)
Show the program expression and verify (`--program-too`)
Show the symbol table along with the SSA (`--ssa-symbol-table`)
Print guard expressions in the SSA output (`--ssa-guards`)
Print the sliced SSAs (`--ssa-sliced`)
Omit location info from the SSA output (`--ssa-no-location`)
Only show the SMT formula; not supported by all solvers (`--smt-formula-only`)
Show the SMT formula and verify; not supported by all solvers (`--smt-formula-too`)
Show the SMT model if the formula is satisfiable; not supported by all solvers (`--smt-model`)
esbmc.frontEnd.printingOptions.markdownDescription: Sets the printing options for the ESBMC frontend

esbmc.frontEnd.resultOnly.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the printing of the counterexample

quiet.description: Output unwinding information during symbolic execution

compact.description: Output a compact representation of the generated counterexample

symex.description: Output the instructions during symbolic execution

ssa.description: Output the SSA during SMT encoding

symex-ssa.description: Output the SSA during symbolic execution

goto-value-set.description: Output the value-set analysis for the goto functions

symex-value-set.description: Output the value-set analysis during symbolic execution

esbmc.trace.options.markdownDescription: Enable or disable certain trace options

esbmc.bmc.claim.markdownDescription: Only check a specific claim, a value of `-1` indicates checking all claims

esbmc.bmc.instruction.markdownDescription: Limit the number of instructions executed during symbolic execution, a value of `-1` enforces no limit

esbmc.bmc.unwind.markdownDescription: Unwind all loops a given number of times a value of `-1` enforces no limit

esbmc.bmc.unwindSet.markdownDescription: Unwind a specific loop a given number of times

esbmc.bmc.unwindingAssertions.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the generation of unwinding assertions

esbmc.bmc.partialUnwinding.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the permision of paths with partial loops

esbmc.bmc.sliceEquations.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the removal of unused equations

esbmc.bmc.initializeNondetVariables.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the initialization of declarations with nondet expression, if it hasn`t a default value

esbmc.bmc.gotoUnwinding.markdownDescription: Enable or unroll bounded loops at goto level

esbmc.bmc.sliceAssumes.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the removal of unused assume statements

esbmc.bmc.incrementalBmc.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the use of incremental loop unwinding verification

esbmc.bmc.falsification.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the use of incremental loop unwinding for bug searching

esbmc.bmc.termination.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the use of incremental loop unwinding assertion verification

markdownEnumDescriptions: Use Boolector
Use MathSAT (`--mathsat`)
Use CVC (`--cvc`); currently an alias for CVC4
Use Yices (`--yices`)
Use Bitwuzla (`--bitwuzla`); the solver ESBMC itself falls back to
Run an external SMT-LIB solver; set `#esbmc.solver.customSmtSolverPath#` and enable `#esbmc.solver.smtLibFormat#` (`--smtlib --smtlib-solver-prog`)
esbmc.solver.smtSolver.markdownDescription: Sets SMT solver used to model check the program

esbmc.solver.customSmtSolverPath.markdownDescription: Sets the program path for the custom SMT solver if `#esbmc.solver.smtSolver#` is set to `custom`

esbmc.solver.smtLibFormat.markdownDescription: Enable or disable the use of the SMT lib format

esbmc.solver.vccOutput.markdownDescription: Sets output file for generated VCCs in SMT lib format

markdownEnumDescriptions: Let the solver choose its arithmetic encoding
Use the solver with bit-vector arithmetic (`--bv`)
Use the solver with integer/real arithmetic (`--ir`); unbounded ranges overapproximate machine integers and reals, which can significantly boost performance
esbmc.solver.arithmetic.markdownDescription: Sets arithmetic used by the solver

markdownEnumDescriptions: Let ESBMC choose the floating-point encoding
Encode floating-point using the SMT floating-point theory (`--floatbv`); ESBMC's default encoding
Encode floating-point as fixed bit-vectors (`--fixedbv`)
Encode floating-point as bit-vectors (`--fp2bv`); the default for solvers without SMT floating-point support
esbmc.solver.floatingPointEncoding.markdownDescription: Sets encoding used for floating point numbers

markdownEnumDescriptions: Let ESBMC choose the tuple encoding
Encode tuples using ESBMC's tuple-to-node API (`--tuple-node-flattener`)
Encode tuples using ESBMC's tuple-to-symbol API (`--tuple-sym-flattener`)
Let ESBMC choose the array encoding
Encode arrays using ESBMC's array API (`--array-flattener`)

esbmc.solver.returnValueOptimisation.markdownDescription: Enable or disable return value optimization to compute the stack size

esbmc.solver.incrementalSmt.markdownDescription: Enable or disable incremental SMT solving **experimental**

esbmc.solver.checkThreadGuard.markdownDescription: Enable or disable checking of the thread guard  during thread exploration **experimental**

esbmc.solver.checkSymexGuard.markdownDescription: Enable or disable checking of conditional goto statements during symbolic execution **experimental**

esbmc.solver.checkSymexAsserts.markdownDescription: Enable or disable checking of assertion statements during symbolic execution **experimental**

structFields.description: Check oversized reads on struct fields

deadlock.description: Check global and local deadlocks with mutex

esbmc.propertyChecking.properties.markdownDescription: Enable or disable checking of certain properties

esbmc.propertyChecking.checkStackLimit.markdownDescription: Check that the stack limit is respected, a value of `-1` indicates that this is not checked

esbmc.propertyChecking.checkErrorLabel.markdownDescription: Check that a given label is unreachable

esbmc.kinduction.checkBaseCase.markdownDescription: Enable or disable checking of the base case

esbmc.kinduction.checkForwardCondition.markdownDescription: Enable or disable checking of the forward condition

esbmc.kinduction.checkInductiveStep.markdownDescription: Enable or disable checking of the inductive step

esbmc.kinduction.prove.markdownDescription: Enable or disable proof by k-induction

esbmc.kinduction.parallelise.markdownDescription: Enable or disable, running each k-Induction step on a separate process if  `#esbmc.kinduction.parallelise#` is true

esbmc.kinduction.iterationMax.markdownDescription: Set the max number of iterations, a value of `-1` indicates `UINT_MAX`

esbmc.concurrencyChecking.contextBound.markdownDescription: Limit the number of number of context switches for each thread, `-1` implies no bound.

esbmc.concurrencyChecking.partialOrderRe.markdownDescription: Enable or disable partial order reduction

esbmc.concurrencyChecking.gotoMerging.markdownDescription: Enable or disable merging of GOTOs when restoring last path after a context switch

esbmc.concurrencyChecking.checkAllInterl.markdownDescription: Enable or disable merging of GOTOs when restoring last path after a context switch

esbmc.ai.enabled.description: Enable Local AI explanation using Ollama.

esbmc.ai.model.description: Ollama model name used for analysis and explanation.

walkthroughs.description: Install ESBMC and find your first bug without leaving the editor.

steps.title: Install ESBMC
steps.description:
ESBMC is a separate binary. Install the latest release, or let the extension pick up one already on your PATH.
[Install ESBMC](command:vscode-esbmc.install)

steps.title: Open the example program
steps.description:
A four-element array written five times — a bug that compiles cleanly.
[Open the example](command:vscode-esbmc.openExample)

steps.title: Verify the file
steps.description:
Run ESBMC over the open file using your current settings.
[Verify file](command:vscode-esbmc.verify.file)

steps.title: Read the counterexample
steps.description: ESBMC reports which property failed, where, and the trace that gets there.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
